newsitem.title: CHINA: China takes control of HK as clock ticks to zero.
newsitem.headline: China takes control of HK as clock ticks to zero.

text.p: China regained control of Hong Kong at midnight on Monday, its resumption of sovereignty marked by a countdown clock erected in the heart of Beijing that ran out on 156 years of British colonial rule over the enclave.
A crowd of 100,000 massed in Beijing's Tiananmen Square shouted out a countdown as the seconds ticked down on the huge digital clock, and raised a huge cheer when the clock showed zero.

The crowd pressed forward to crane for a glimpse of the clock and shouted with delight as huge television screens in the square broadcast live as Britain's Union Jack was lowered and China's scarlet flag emblazoned with five gold stars was raised at the handover ceremony in Hong Kong.
The sky above the square exploded in a huge show of fireworks when the countdown clock showed zero hour -- midnight (1600 GMT).

Applause burst from the crowd as President Jiang Zemin appeared on the huge television screens to make a speech in Hong Kong taking back the territory that becomes China's first Special Administrative Region.
"I'm so excited," said policeman Chen Baojing. "We have accomplished the recovery of our authority over Hong Kong."
